verdict.rationale: Terraform configurations are human-readable files designed to be versioned and shared. Changes can be reviewed before execution via `terraform plan`, saved plan files (`-out`), JSON plan output, tests and policy checks, and the community confirms that plans make iteration safe. Rollback is not documented in the pack; reverting config and re-applying is only implied by versioned files plus plan/apply. Missing for 10: documented rollback or revert-to-previous-state workflow, built-in version history of applied runs, independent hands-on corroboration of a version/review/rollback loop.
